research_question: When every required action primitive already exists but the correct bound candidate instance is absent from the candidate list, can a generic deterministic symbolic composer construct the candidate set without material loss versus Qwen2.5-1.5B?

deterministic_engine.rule: generic parameter binding + precondition satisfaction + required-effect overlap + forbidden-effect exclusion

qwen_arm.output_contract: JSON array of {action_class, bindings}; action_class and binding values must come from visible primitive vocabulary/domains

holdout_rules: generator is frozen after this contract and core freeze
no reuse of the eight S2B metadata-blind fixtures
gold is explicitly authored in generator cases and is not derived by calling the deterministic core
every gold action_class must already exist in primitive_actions
no gold candidate instance may appear in existing_candidates
no prompt/grammar/threshold/core change after generator freeze
claim_limit: A pass establishes composition/binding from an already supplied symbolic primitive ontology only. It is not evidence for invention of a missing action class/operator.
stage_b_gate: Stage B ontology-invention assay may begin only after Stage A evidence is frozen and audited.
